title: Repository save and move decide on the resolved file name and refuse trailing-separator .sds spellings; the loader reads only the /datasources tree

criteria.given: a non-admin save or move whose path resolves to a *.sds descriptor via a trailing-separator spelling (x.sds/, x.sds/., x.sds//, x.SDS/)
criteria.then: the repository manager's guard runs on the RESOLVED file name (after resolveWithinDatadir) and the resource refuses with 403 before the service layer is reached, so nothing is written

it lives in FilesystemRepositoryManager (requireAdminForDatasourceDescriptor), resolves the request path first, and gates save and BOTH ends of move — including a move whose source resolves to a descriptor

criteria.given: datasource loading at start-up and on admin-role discover/refresh (getAllDataSources)
criteria.then: it lists *.sds only under the /datasources subtree, so a descriptor anywhere else (a user's writable home) is never loaded
it collapses trailing separators and dot segments before the .sds extension check, and still lets admin datasource writes (saveDataSource to /datasources/<name>.sds) and ordinary user files through
